title: It gets rejected when I try to send a contract with a 40 MB attachment
description: I need to send a contract to a customer, the attachment is 40 MB. Exchange gives a 'size exceeded' error.

worklogs.description: File uploaded to OneDrive, share link created.
Explained to the user in detail how to attach the link.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The Exchange limit is 25 MB. Upload your file to OneDrive, create a link with the 'Share' button, and add it to your email. You can call me for a step-by-step walkthrough.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I sent the link, the customer downloaded it. Thanks.

resolutionNote: Recommended using a OneDrive share link instead of a large attachment, user completed the process.

csat.comment: Good suggestion, but it would be more practical if the Exchange limit were raised.
